// Crate roots no single literal spells as a scope item: each must be refused.
fn pieced(runtime: &str) -> String {
    format!("pub use {runtime}::*;\nmod ffi;")
}

fn bytes() -> &'static [u8] {
    b"pub use ipe_runtime::error::IpeError;"
}

fn inline_module() -> String {
    String::from("mod ffi { include!(\"ffi.rs\"); }")
}
